description: [WRITE] Create a Yelp Conversion API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/yelp-tag), imported automatically. Yelp has no pixel id: only the accessToken from Yelp Ads. Omit `event` to inherit; purchase/add_to_cart/checkout/lead/view_content/signup/… or a GA4 name are standard. eventId is the dedup row; validate runs Yelp's payload validation. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

accessToken.description: Yelp Ads access token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

customData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Yelp CAPI Tag".

serverData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_yelp_capi_server_tag
